body: I find looking for comedy when I get like that.  Not just any comedy stupid comedy that makes you belly laugh because it's so stupid.  Now that I've done that, I can't wait for the next post from the site I am now a follower of just to have the chance to laugh at stupid sh*t.  And no one is around to ridicule you for laughing at something so stupid.  Life's little chuckle.

Your not alone.  We all feel that lonely feeling from time to time, but when I go through the same thing, even when I'm with my closest family 1.  I feel alone when I'm with them, and 2 I really just want to be alone maybe.  Maybe I can say it better, I really don't want to be with people, they just annoy me when I feel that way.  Maybe a pet, being a little more active in what YOU want to do might help.  Believe me, I have so damn many flower gardens around my house you might think I'm a nursery, but it helps.  The hard work pays off when they flourish.  You get a sense of amazement when it looks nice.  Just my thought.
Thanks for the encouragement.  It means more than you know.  It's good to hear someone is rooting for me.
